muse_spark_1.3/001: Breakthrough is a race with tactics. The policy uses fast bitboards, iterative deepening negamax with alpha-beta, immediate-win detection, capture-first ordering and a positional evaluation based on material, advancement, centre, passed pawns and hanging/defended pieces. Search runs until ~0.9s and always falls back to a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/002: The strategy is a fast bitboard alpha-beta search for Breakthrough. White moves +8, Black -8, diagonals are allowed to empty squares or captures, straight only to empty. Win is promotion to the far rank or annihilation. Evaluation is material + advancement + centre + attack/defence plus Breakthrough theory: forward cone masks for unstoppable runners, one-move promotion / last-piece capture threats, and a race calculation where the player to move wins ties. Moves are ordered by promotion, capture and advancement with a transposition table and iterative deepening under a time deadline, with instant return of any immediate winning move.
muse_spark_1.3/003: Strategy is alpha-beta negamax with iterative deepening, quiescence and Breakthrough-specific evaluation. Board is bitboards in Python ints. Evaluation = material 100 + advancement by rank + centre + defender/attacker + blocked penalty + passed-pawn bonus. Passed status uses precomputed cone masks: opponent in front cone blocks passed status. Move ordering puts promotions/captures first. Root searches depths 1..7 until ~0.88s deadline, keeping best from last completed depth. Immediate winning moves are returned instantly. Timeout aborts search via node counter, guaranteeing a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/004: The strategy is a fast bitboard alpha-beta engine for Breakthrough. Board is two 64-bit ints, move generation allows forward to empty and diagonal to non-own, promotion or capture-all is immediate win. Evaluation from White perspective combines material, exponential advancement + centre PST, defended bonus, hanging penalty and passed-pawn masks for squares ahead on 3 files. Root checks instant win, orders captures and advancing moves first, then iterative-deepening negamax with alpha-beta, win-distance scoring and time abort, guaranteeing a legal move.
muse_spark_1.3/005: The strategy is deep alpha-beta search with Breakthrough specific evaluation. Wins are immediate promotions, material is base value, advancement is non-linear with a huge bonus one step from promotion since any pawn on the 2nd-last rank can promote next move, centre and hanging-piece penalties shape play, captures and promotions are ordered first and quiescence extends captures to avoid horizon effects. Iterative deepening under a time budget picks the best move with a safe fallback to a legal move.
